user.title: Zigbang / Samsung Doorlock
user.description: Sign in with your doorlock app account. The integration logs in itself and finds your lock automatically.

pick_lock.title: Choose a doorlock
pick_lock.description: This account has more than one doorlock. Pick one to add now; add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again for this doorlock (for example after a password change).

error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected by the server.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the doorlock cloud.
error.no_locks: Login succeeded but no doorlock was found on this account.
error.wrong_account: This account does not have access to this doorlock.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: All doorlocks on this account are already configured.

init.title: Doorlock options
init.description: The server returns event text in this language. Chinese is Traditional for zh_TW, Simplified otherwise.

data_description.status_interval: How often the lock status is read from the cloud (5–300 s, default 8). Higher values put less load on the vendor service, especially with several locks, but door changes show up later.
